## Methodology — The Leak Audit™
A 7-step forensic process for finding and fixing the revenue leaks owners can't see from the inside:
1. Vocabulary friction (words on your site that lose deals silently)
2. Brand contradictions (what you promise vs. what you deliver)
3. Conversion drop-offs (where prospects quietly leave)
4. Follow-up failures (the lead you never closed the loop on)
5. System disconnects (CRM, calendar, email, intake — talking past each other)
6. Operational waste (manual work that should have been automated three years ago)
7. Growth ceilings (what's blocking the next $1M without more headcount)

Free self-scan: https://aetheris.technology/leak-audit
Operator-led version: $2,500 Forensic Diagnostic (applied 1:1 toward any engagement)
